headline: 7 leaders, including Obaidul Quader, sentenced to death for crimes against humanity
summary: A tribunal has ordered the death penalty for seven leaders of the banned Awami League and Chhatra League, while ordering the half of their assets to be confiscated.
details: A tribunal has sentenced seven leaders of the banned Awami League and Chhatra League to death for crimes against humanity committed during the July uprising. The convicts, who are all currently fugitives, include Awami League General Secretary Obaidul Quader and former State Minister for Information and Broadcasting Mohammad Ali Arafat.
caption:
Seven top leaders of the banned Awami League and Chhatra League have been sentenced to death for crimes against humanity.

A tribunal has sentenced seven leaders of the banned Awami League and Chhatra League to death for crimes against humanity committed during the July uprising. The convicts, who are all currently fugitives, include Awami League General Secretary Obaidul Quader and former State Minister for Information and Broadcasting Mohammad Ali Arafat.

headline: Crude bomb explodes in front of Supreme Court amid war crimes verdict
summary: Two unidentified individuals on a motorcycle threw a crude bomb near the main gate of the Supreme Court, causing an explosion. The incident occurred shortly after a war crimes tribunal sentenced seven individuals, including a ruling party general secretary, to
details: A crude bomb exploded in front of the main gate of the Supreme Court in Dhaka on Tuesday afternoon. The perpetrators and their motives remain unclear.

The explosion took place around 1:15 PM, shortly after the International Crimes Tribunal-2 delivered a death sentence to seven individuals, including Awami League General Secretary Obaidul Quader, for crimes against humanity during the 1971 Liberation War.

According to Shahbagh Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Md. Moniruzzaman, two individuals on a motorcycle approached the main gate, threw the bomb onto the road, and fled the scene. The bomb detonated shortly after.
The Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) Bomb Disposal Unit visited the site and collected evidence. Authorities are reviewing CCTV footage to identify the two suspects involved in the incident.
caption:
A crude bomb exploded outside the Supreme Court in Dhaka shortly after a war crimes tribunal handed down death sentences to seven individuals.

A crude bomb exploded in front of the main gate of the Supreme Court in Dhaka on Tuesday afternoon. The perpetrators and their motives remain unclear.

The explosion took place around 1:15 PM, shortly after the International Crimes Tribunal-2 delivered a death sentence to seven individuals, including Awami League General Secretary Obaidul Quader, for crimes against humanity during the 1971 Liberation War.

According to Shahbagh Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Md. Moniruzzaman, two individuals on a motorcycle approached the main gate, threw the bomb onto the road, and fled the scene. The bomb detonated shortly after.

The Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) Bomb Disposal Unit visited the site and collected evidence. Authorities are reviewing CCTV footage to identify the two suspects involved in the incident.
